newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarian Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs, on a visit in Germany, cautiously welcomed the U.S.'s support for Hungarian, Czech and Polish NATO membership.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn will meet on Tuesday representatives of Hungary's "historic" churches to discuss church financing and the planned agreement with the Vatican.
- Semjen Zsolt has accepted a nomination to presidential candidate of opposition party Christian Democtars.
- Taxpayers are again receiving false letters pretending to be Tax Office claims for 40,000 forints.
- Former Debrecen soccer player Tamas Sandor has signed a contract with Italy's Torino.
